rubricLimits: Signals are title + description chapters + runtime. Series numbering ('Set - 1', 'Part 1') can false-positive as concept; the mis-shelved list needs eyeballing. NO-SIGNAL means the description carried no chapters and the title no lexicon — not that the row is wrong.
